formal_regulation.admission_goal: Promote stable formal regulation text such as 办法, 规定, 细则, 条例, 章程, 准则, 指导意见.

normative_handbook.admission_goal: Promote stable normative handbook text that can be consumed as a standalone institutional document.

wrapper_notice_only.reason: The notice itself is only the publication wrapper and must not become a regulation document.

manual_promotion_review.reason: Use when the document may be regulation-like but title/body/provenance/version signals are still ambiguous.

institutional_regulation.description: Stable institutional regulation or normative handbook text that can stand on its own in regulations/institutional_regulations.

annual_cycle_rule.description: Year-scoped, batch-scoped, or program-scoped regulation text such as admissions, recommendation, or selection procedures. These import into regulations/scoped_rules and must keep document_nature metadata for downstream handling.

time_bound_operational_rule.description: Operational rules tied to seasonal, transitional, or explicitly temporary operating conditions. These import into regulations/scoped_rules and must keep document_nature metadata for downstream handling. Provisional wording alone is insufficient; the body must carry temporary or sunset semantics.

wrapper_notice.description: Publication wrapper or forwarding notice that points at a regulation body but is not itself the canonical regulation text.

current_effective.description: No supersession evidence was found and the text behaves like an in-force institutional rule.

provisional_in_force.description: The title/body uses 暂行 or 试行, but there is no body-level sunset or replacement evidence yet.

superseded_or_expired.description: There is explicit repeal, replacement, or time-bound sunset evidence.

unknown.description: Currentness cannot be safely inferred from available source-truth artifacts.

notes: This file is a repo-tracked scaffold for the regulation-promotion boundary only; it is not yet consumed by execution code.
Promotion never deletes or rewrites the source-triage notice row in campus_notices/internal_notice.
Only canonical regulation text may cross into regulations/institutional_regulations.
source_attachment_ref_id and source_attachment_sha256 are attachment-derived provenance fields; parent-body candidates may keep them null.
effective_date is preserved when the owner text explicitly states it, but it is not a promotion hard gate.
source_notice_release_time is notice-issued provenance metadata and must not be silently rewritten into effective_date.

Current execution identity now uses regulation_work_title; current projected/materialized title uses regulation_display_title when present, while regulation_title_normalized and source_title_literal remain source-facing title metadata.
Document age is not a standalone exclusion or downgrade signal for campus regulations.
暂行 or 试行 is not by itself a draft, expired, or manual-review signal.
Exclude from institutional_regulations only when the body remains wrapper-only, draft/consultation, operational-scheme-like, or otherwise lacks promotable canonical regulation text.
Per-document target_collection is authoritative for downstream consumers; annual-cycle and time-bound operational documents now route to regulations/scoped_rules instead of institutional_regulations.
